name: gloss-review
description: Files-first design review: an agent condenses a repo's design into decidable facts, a human reviews them, the approved revision drives implementation

scripts.build: bun build src/viewer/client.tsx --target=browser --production --format=iife --outfile src/viewer/client.gen.js && ./node_modules/.bin/tailwindcss -i src/viewer/styles.css -o src/viewer/client.gen.css --minify && bun build src/viewer/mermaid-entry.ts --target=browser --production --format=iife --outfile src/viewer/mermaid.gen.js && bun build src/gloss.ts --target=node --banner '#!/usr/bin/env node' --outfile dist/gloss.js && chmod +x dist/gloss.js
